title: Loa Composition
description: Schema for grimoires/compositions/*.yaml — runtime expert chains executed by compose-run.sh. A composition declares which constructs collaborate on what, with declared streams + iteration boundaries. The shape emerges from naming what the workflow provides; the schema enforces consistency, not prescription.

schema_version.description: Composition schema version. Bump on breaking changes to this schema.

kind.description: Composition kind. 'workflow' = runtime expert chain (current default, doctrine v4 §15.2). 'frame' = reserved for cycle-007+ frame-kind compositions.

name.description: Composition slug. Must match the filename (without .yaml extension). Kebab-case.

description.description: What this composition does, in one or two sentences. Lead with what it provides.

intent.description: Operator-voice statement of the workflow's intent. The 'I want X out of this' framing in the operator's words.

backend.description: Runtime backend (doctrine v6 §18.4). 'headless-tmux' is cycle-006 default; 'teamcreate' ships in cycle-007.

inputs.description: Declared inputs the composition accepts. Operators bind these at invocation time.

items.description: Pair [stage_a, stage_b] of stage numbers that iterate together.

iterate.description: Iteration loops between pairs of stages. Each pair must reference stage numbers that exist in chain[].stage. Cap behavior is runner-controlled (--max-iterations).

chain.description: Ordered list of stages. Stage numbers must be 1-indexed and contiguous.

outputs.description: Declared outputs the composition produces. Destination paths typically use .run/compose/<run_id>/...

compose_with.description: Construct slugs this composition orchestrates. Should match the unique set of chain[].construct values.

items.description: Symmetric pair declaration in the form 'A ↔ B' or 'A <-> B'.

composes_symmetrically_with.description: Confirmed symmetric construct/skill pairs surfaced by GECKO §2 or by operator validation.

invocation_examples.description: Example operator utterances and how they resolve to this composition (or sub-chains of it).

when_to_use.description: Plain-prose guidance on when this composition is the right tool. May include WHEN-NOT-TO-USE bullets.

known_limitations.description: Surfaced limitations — cost, reproducibility, runner gaps, etc. Empty array discouraged; honest enumeration preferred.

items.description: Single-key reference entry. Keys are snake_case identifiers (e.g. 'doctrine', 'runner', 'exemplar_eye_hand'); values are paths or URLs.

references.description: Pointers to doctrine, runner scripts, exemplar compositions, related skills.

operator_note.description: Free-form note for downstream operators, especially when the composition serves as a teaching artifact. Use a YAML literal block scalar (|) for multi-line content.

version.description: Composition revision number (strict semver X.Y.Z). Increment on substantive changes to chain, inputs, or outputs.

StreamType.description: Stream type per pipe doctrine. Question is reserved for cycle-007+.

Mode.description: Stage execution mode. 'fresh' = clean subprocess per invocation (no prior context). 'persistent' = teammate accumulates register depth across iterations.

Role.description: Stage role. 'primary' = owns the substantive work. 'craft-gate' = validates against quality standard. 'cross-reference' = enriches a Verdict with second-construct context.

destination.description: Path or path template. May contain <run_id> placeholder.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema path for output validation (e.g., .claude/schemas/feedback-v3.schema.json).

stage.description: 1-indexed stage number; must be contiguous within chain.

iterates_with.description: Companion stage number for iteration. Must reference an entry in iterate[].

iterate_until.description: Termination predicate for the iteration loop (operator/runner-defined).

notes.description: What this stage does and why this expert was chosen.

operator_utterance.description: The natural-language way an operator might invoke this composition.

resolves_to.description: What chain or sub-chain executes for this utterance.
